### Changes

- Add Panasonic HLG Photo (`.HSP`) and ISO gain-map HEIF/HEIC input support.
- Improve Apple Adaptive HDR reference-white handling and Gain Map extraction.
- Fix Ultra HDR JPEG exports from sources with oversized Exif metadata.
- Improve HEVC decoding consistency between Web and Windows.
- Preserve the Windows preview window’s size and position when switching images.
